observations: Photo 0 shows a black electronic keyboard with white and black keys.
The brand 'CASIO' is visible vertically on the left side of the control panel.
The model 'CTK-558' is printed vertically near the bottom left of the control panel.
The keyboard has a small LCD screen, several control buttons, and two blue rotary knobs.
There are visible marks and smudges on some black keys, especially near the top left.
The surface of the keyboard has a sticker or overlay with diagrams and text, including 'ENJOY ON' and 'MUSIC PRODUCTION'.
The keyboard has built-in speakers on both top and bottom right corners.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI REMY.BAMY' is overlaid on the image.

claims.claim: Clean home keyboard for leaners and beginners
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows visible smudges and marks on several black keys, indicating it is not clean. The term 'leaners' is likely a typo for 'learners'.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not function properly (e.g., keys not responding, sound issues, or internal damage)
risks.proof: A video showing all keys being pressed and producing sound, and a test of all functions including volume, rhythm, and demo songs.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, or headphones)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in photo (e.g., cracked casing, loose buttons, or internal wear)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, buttons, and connections, including underside and back panel.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard in operation, testing all keys and functions.
Close-up photos of the keyboard's edges, buttons, and back panel.
response.reason: The keyboard is identifiable as a CASIO CTK-558, but visible marks on keys contradict the seller's claim of being 'clean'. Functionality and accessories are unverified, and hidden damage cannot be ruled out without further proof. A worst-case price cannot be assigned without confirming working condition and included items.
